findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_guide · Private data: get_place_directory, get_property_facts, county_parcel_data · Public sink: resolve_jurisdiction, county_parcel_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_guide · Private data: get_place_directory, get_property_facts, county_parcel_data · Public sink: resolve_jurisdiction, county_parcel_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "resolve_jurisdiction" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
